dogecoin.text: I'm optimistic that a few smart people used #dogecoin to dip their toes into #crypto, and now have major profits to put into #Cardano #Ethereum and #LINK plus a smattering of their favorite smaller projects

#dogecoin was never going to moon on #doge420.  Look at the 100x+ gains over the last year.  Did it not already moon?

If anything, today is the day the billionaires will finish dumping, leaving the bags with "HODLers" that didn't do their due diligence on real #cryptocurrency
